name: thinwindow
description: Less in the window. Less on the bill. ThinWindow makes Claude Code use less context — without changing the outcome. A Claude Code plugin and Agent Skill, benchmarked on Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 4.5: 7–11% lower cost, 3–6% fewer tokens, with the same success rate.
